headline: Chime to cut 10% of workforce

headline: Pinterest laying off 15% of workforce as part of AI push; stock plummets

headline: Vanta Raises $150M Series D to Power the Future of AI-Driven Trust

headline: Security compliance unicorn Drata lays off 9% of its workforce
